title: Qt: Sort SCTP All Associations items numerically
description:
Call setData on each QTableWidgetItem, which will interpret each
string item as a QVariant and make it sort properly, instead of
creating a string from them. (This could be rewritten with a
QTableView and a model, but this is a simple table and this works
for now.)

Per the Qt documentation for QTableWidget, turn off sorting before
adding many items to the same row in a loop.

Resize the columns to their contents using the size hint instead
of guessing at a fixed width, which isn't correct for many fonts.

Fix #19652
